title: Effect of oral administration of nicotinamide mononucleotide on clinical parameters and nicotinamide metabolite levels in healthy Japanese men
primary_outcomes_measured: Safety (clinical symptoms, heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, temperature, laboratory tests, eye examination, sleep quality) and plasma NMN metabolites
authors_reported_result: The authors reported no significant clinical symptoms or changes in vital signs; some laboratory values shifted within normal ranges; plasma NMN metabolites (2-PY and 4-PY) rose with dose.
funding_or_conflicts: Supported by Keio University internal budgets. NMN supplied by Oriental Yeast Co., Ltd.; one author received research funding from Oriental Yeast and three authors were employed by Shionogi & Co. (per paper).
verified_from: PubMed record and full text (J-STAGE)

title: Nicotinamide mononucleotide supplementation enhances aerobic capacity in amateur runners: a randomized, double-blind study
journal: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
population: Recreationally trained runners (40 men, 8 women) in a training programme
primary_outcomes_measured: Aerobic capacity on cardiopulmonary exercise testing
authors_reported_result: The authors reported larger increases in oxygen uptake and power at the ventilatory thresholds in the 600mg and 1,200mg groups than on placebo; VO2max, O2-pulse and peak power did not differ from baseline in any group.
funding_or_conflicts: National Key Research and Development Program of China. Authors declared no conflict of interest.
verified_from: PubMed record and PMC full text

title: The Impacts of Short-Term NMN Supplementation on Serum Metabolism, Fecal Microbiota, and Telomere Length in Pre-Aging Phase
design: Open-label, uncontrolled human arm within a mainly animal study
population: Men in a pre-ageing age band (human volunteer arm)
primary_outcomes_measured: Telomere length in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (human arm)
authors_reported_result: The authors reported longer PBMC telomere length after NMN in the human volunteers, and noted the clinical part had no placebo group and a small number of participants.
funding_or_conflicts: Provincial research grants (Tianjin, Hunan, Jiangxi). Two authors employed by ERA Biotechnology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. (per paper).
verified_from: PubMed record and PMC full text

title: Nicotinamide mononucleotide increases muscle insulin sensitivity in prediabetic women
population: Postmenopausal women with prediabetes who were overweight or obese
primary_outcomes_measured: Insulin-stimulated glucose disposal (hyperinsulinaemic-euglycaemic clamp), skeletal muscle insulin signalling, muscle gene expression
authors_reported_result: The authors reported that insulin-stimulated glucose disposal and muscle insulin signalling increased after NMN and did not change after placebo.
funding_or_conflicts: NIH grants and other non-commercial support. NMN and placebo capsules provided by Oriental Yeast Co., Ltd. Authors disclosed NMN-related patents and licensing interests (per paper).
verified_from: PubMed record, PMC full text and ClinicalTrials.gov

title: Safety evaluation of β-nicotinamide mononucleotide oral administration in healthy adult men and women
primary_outcomes_measured: Safety: anthropometry, haematology, biochemistry, urinalysis, body composition, adverse events
authors_reported_result: The authors reported no changes beyond physiological variation and no severe adverse events.
funding_or_conflicts: Funded by Mitsubishi Corporation Life Sciences Limited, which provided the test foods; five authors were its employees (per paper).
verified_from: PubMed record and PMC full text

title: A Multicentre, Randomised, Double Blind, Parallel Design, Placebo Controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Uthever (NMN Supplement), an Orally Administered Supplementation in Middle Aged and Older Adults
design: Randomised controlled trial, parallel group, multicentre
primary_outcomes_measured: Serum NAD+/NADH, six-minute walk test, blood pressure, SF-36
authors_reported_result: The authors reported a larger rise in serum NAD+/NADH with NMN than placebo at day 60, while their own table shows the between-group difference was not statistically significant; they also reported changes in SF-36 and HOMA-IR.
funding_or_conflicts: The author was employed by Effepharm (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., the registered sponsor and maker of the Uthever NMN product (per paper and ClinicalTrials.gov).
verified_from: PubMed record, PMC full text and ClinicalTrials.gov

title: Chronic nicotinamide mononucleotide supplementation elevates blood nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide levels and alters muscle function in healthy older men
duration_text: 6 or 12 weeks (12-week data from 20 participants after a supplier error)
primary_outcomes_measured: Whole-blood NAD+ and body composition (skeletal muscle index)
authors_reported_result: The authors reported higher whole-blood NAD+ and related metabolites with NMN, nominally significant changes in gait speed and left grip strength that need larger studies, and no effect on body composition. The paper reports that 22 participants received the wrong supplement after week 6 because of a supplier error; their 12-week data were excluded.
funding_or_conflicts: Funded by Mitsubishi Corporation Life Sciences Limited, which provided the NMN; three authors were its employees (per paper).
verified_from: PubMed record and PMC full text

title: Effect of 12-Week Intake of Nicotinamide Mononucleotide on Sleep Quality, Fatigue, and Physical Performance in Older Japanese Adults: A Randomized, Double-Blind Placebo-Controlled Study
design: Randomised controlled trial, four arms (morning or afternoon dosing)
primary_outcomes_measured: Sleep quality (Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index) and fatigue questionnaires; physical performance as secondary outcome
authors_reported_result: The authors reported significant interactions for five-times sit-to-stand and drowsiness, with the largest effect sizes in the afternoon NMN group.
funding_or_conflicts: Supported by Mitsubishi Corporation Life Sciences Ltd., which supplied NMN and placebo (per paper).
verified_from: PubMed record and PMC full text

title: Clinical evaluation of changes in biomarkers by oral intake of NMN
primary_outcomes_measured: Body measurements, blood biochemistry, hormones, SIRT1 expression, NMN/NAD/NAM levels, immune markers, skin visual analogue scale
authors_reported_result: The authors reported significant before-and-after changes in nicotinamide, adiponectin, skin scores and several other markers, with no safety problems among the 16 completers; one participant withdrew with persistent mild headache.
funding_or_conflicts: Authors declared no conflict of interest; one author is affiliated with Antiaging-Bank Co., Ltd. (per paper).
verified_from: DOI and full text (J-STAGE); not indexed in PubMed

title: Oral Administration of Nicotinamide Mononucleotide Is Safe and Efficiently Increases Blood Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide Levels in Healthy Subjects
primary_outcomes_measured: Safety (physical measurements, blood and urine tests, symptoms); whole-blood NAD+ and related metabolites
authors_reported_result: The authors reported no abnormalities in physiological or laboratory tests and higher whole-blood NAD+ after NMN.
funding_or_conflicts: Funded by Mitsubishi Corporation Life Sciences Limited, which prepared the NMN and placebo; four authors were its employees (per paper).
verified_from: PubMed record and PMC full text

title: Effects of nicotinamide mononucleotide on older patients with diabetes and impaired physical performance: A prospective, placebo-controlled, double-blind study
population: Older men with diabetes and reduced grip strength or walking speed
primary_outcomes_measured: Safety; change in grip strength and walking speed
authors_reported_result: The authors reported NMN was tolerated without severe adverse events and did not improve grip strength or walking speed compared with placebo.
funding_or_conflicts: PubMed lists a grant from Teijin Ltd.
verified_from: PubMed record

title: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide metabolism and arterial stiffness after long-term nicotinamide mononucleotide supplementation: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
primary_outcomes_measured: Serum NAD+, NMN and nicotinamide; SIRT1 expression
authors_reported_result: The authors reported higher serum nicotinamide with NMN than placebo; pulse wave velocity tended to fall with NMN but did not differ significantly between groups; no adverse events.
funding_or_conflicts: Supported by a research grant from DHC Corporation. Authors declared no competing interests.
verified_from: PubMed record and PMC full text

title: MIB-626, an Oral Formulation of a Microcrystalline Unique Polymorph of β-Nicotinamide Mononucleotide, Increases Circulating Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide and its Metabolome in Middle-Aged and Older Adults
journal: The Journals of Gerontology: Series A
primary_outcomes_measured: Pharmacokinetics of NMN and blood NAD+ and its metabolome
authors_reported_result: The authors reported that MIB-626 was well tolerated and associated with dose-related increases in blood NAD+ and its metabolites.
funding_or_conflicts: Product: MIB-626 (Metro International Biotech). Co-authors list Metro International Biotech affiliations on PubMed.
verified_from: PubMed record

title: Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide Augmentation in Overweight or Obese Middle-Aged and Older Adults: A Physiologic Study
journal: The Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism
primary_outcomes_measured: Safety; NAD+ and metabolome; body weight, body fat, insulin sensitivity, blood pressure, lipids, physical performance
authors_reported_result: The authors reported higher circulating NAD+ and greater falls in body weight, diastolic blood pressure, total, LDL and non-HDL cholesterol than placebo; muscle strength, aerobic capacity, insulin sensitivity and liver fat did not differ.
funding_or_conflicts: PubMed lists NIA and NIDDK (NIH) grants and Metro International Biotech, maker of MIB-626.
verified_from: PubMed record

title: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) intake increases plasma NMN and insulin levels in healthy subjects
design: Single-group intervention (no control group described in abstract)
primary_outcomes_measured: Plasma NMN and NAD+; postprandial physiological and laboratory tests
authors_reported_result: The authors reported higher plasma NMN, NAD+ and postprandial serum insulin, with wide variation between individuals and no adverse symptoms.
funding_or_conflicts: Not stated in the PubMed record. Authors affiliated with BYU-Analytica Inc. and Osaka University.
verified_from: PubMed record

title: The efficacy and safety of β-nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) supplementation in healthy middle-aged adults: a randomized, multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group, dose-dependent clinical trial
design: Randomised controlled trial, parallel group, multicentre, dose comparison
primary_outcomes_measured: Blood NAD concentration
authors_reported_result: The authors reported higher blood NAD in all NMN groups at days 30 and 60, highest at 600mg and 900mg; six-minute walk distance rose more than on placebo; HOMA-IR did not differ from placebo; no safety issues were found.
funding_or_conflicts: Fully funded by Aba Chemicals Co. and Abinopharm, Inc.; three authors were employees of these companies (per paper).
verified_from: PubMed record, PMC full text and ClinicalTrials.gov

title: Ingestion of β-nicotinamide mononucleotide increased blood NAD levels, maintained walking speed, and improved sleep quality in older adults in a double-blind randomized, placebo-controlled study
primary_outcomes_measured: Stepping test (motor function)
authors_reported_result: The authors reported no difference from placebo on the primary stepping test; for secondary outcomes, 4-metre walking time was shorter, blood NAD+ higher and two sleep questionnaire scores better than placebo at 12 weeks.
funding_or_conflicts: Three authors are employees of Meiji Holdings Co., Ltd. (per PubMed record).
verified_from: PubMed record

title: Safety and efficacy of long-term nicotinamide mononucleotide supplementation on metabolism, sleep, and nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide biosynthesis in healthy, middle-aged Japanese men
design: Single-arm, open-label (with a placebo run-in period)
primary_outcomes_measured: Safety; biochemical, metabolic, eye and sleep measures; NAD+ in peripheral blood cells
authors_reported_result: The authors reported the regimen was well tolerated and NAD+ in peripheral blood mononuclear cells rose over the 8 weeks; in three participants with high insulin secretion, postprandial insulin was modestly lower.
funding_or_conflicts: Supported by Keio University internal budgets. NMN and placebo supplied by Oriental Yeast Co., Ltd.; one author received research funding from Oriental Yeast; authors disclosed NMN-related patents (per paper).
verified_from: PubMed record and full text (J-STAGE)

title: Oral MIB-626 (β Nicotinamide Mononucleotide) Safely Raises Blood Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide Levels in Hospitalized Patients With COVID-19 and Acute Kidney Injury: A Randomized Controlled Trial
design: Randomised controlled trial, 3:2 allocation, three sites
population: Adults hospitalised with COVID-19 and acute kidney injury
primary_outcomes_measured: Blood NAD+ and its metabolites; safety
authors_reported_result: The authors reported that blood NAD+ rose gradually with MIB-626; markers of kidney injury, inflammation and disease severity did not differ between groups.
funding_or_conflicts: Two authors are employees of Metro International Biotech, maker of MIB-626, and others report research support from it (per paper).
verified_from: PubMed record, PMC full text and ClinicalTrials.gov

title: The NAD-brain pharmacokinetic study of NAD augmentation in blood and brain using oral precursor supplementation
design: Open-label crossover (NMN stage of a phase I pharmacokinetic study)
population: Healthy adults (NMN was given in stage 1 only)
primary_outcomes_measured: Change in whole-blood NAD and cerebral NAD (31P-MRS)
authors_reported_result: The authors reported that blood NAD rose slowly and declined slowly after stopping, with considerable variation between individuals.
funding_or_conflicts: Research Council of Norway, Western Norway Regional Health Authority and Norway's Parkinson Research Fund; NMN was bought from an online supplier; two authors hold patent applications on nicotinamide riboside (per paper).
verified_from: PubMed record and PMC full text

title: The differential impact of three different NAD+ boosters on circulatory NAD and microbial metabolism in humans
design: Randomised controlled trial, four arms (NMN, NR, nicotinamide, placebo)
primary_outcomes_measured: Change in whole-blood NAD+ after 14 days
authors_reported_result: The authors reported that NR and NMN, but not nicotinamide, raised circulating NAD+ to a comparable degree over 14 days.
funding_or_conflicts: Sponsored by Société des Produits Nestlé; most authors are Nestlé employees (per paper and ClinicalTrials.gov).
verified_from: PubMed record, PMC full text and ClinicalTrials.gov

title: Low-dose oral nicotinamide mononucleotide for immune thrombocytopenia: a phase 1/2 trial
population: Adults with steroid-refractory or steroid-dependent immune thrombocytopenia
primary_outcomes_measured: Safety and tolerability; platelet response
authors_reported_result: The authors reported no dose-limiting toxicities or treatment-related serious adverse events; 5 of 25 patients (20%) met the primary platelet-response endpoint.
funding_or_conflicts: Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences, National Natural Science Foundation of China and Tianjin science foundations. Authors declared no competing interests.
verified_from: PubMed record and ClinicalTrials.gov

title: Sublingual NMN administration increases early circulating terminal catabolites 2PY and 4PY compared with oral administration in healthy adult men
design: Randomised two-period crossover, single dose (oral vs sublingual)
blinded: Described by the authors as double-blind
primary_outcomes_measured: Blood NMN concentration over 60 minutes
authors_reported_result: The authors reported no difference between routes in blood NMN, nicotinamide or NAD+, and higher early 2PY and 4PY after sublingual dosing.
funding_or_conflicts: Funded by internal funds of Meiji Holdings Co., Ltd.; three authors are Meiji employees (per paper).
verified_from: PubMed record and PMC full text

title: Anti-inflammatory effects of nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) in human skeletal muscle after BFR-exercise
journal: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
population: Untrained young men doing blood-flow-restriction resistance exercise
primary_outcomes_measured: Cell infiltration and mitochondrial content in muscle biopsies after exercise
authors_reported_result: The authors reported that NMN suppressed exercise-induced increases in TNF-alpha and IL-10 mRNA, and that the rise in muscle mitochondrial content seen after exercise on placebo did not occur with NMN.
funding_or_conflicts: National Science and Technology Council, Taiwan. Authors reported no conflicts. NMN product: AbinoNutra (per paper).
verified_from: PubMed record and PMC full text

title: The effects of pyrroloquinoline quinone and nicotinamide mononucleotide supplementation on interoception following acute exhaustive exercise: a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled study
design: Randomised controlled trial, four arms (PQQ, NMN, both, placebo), single dose
primary_outcomes_measured: Interoception questionnaires (BPQ, MAIA) after exhaustive treadmill exercise
authors_reported_result: The authors reported no significant within-group change in the NMN group; the only group-by-time interaction (body listening) favoured the PQQ group.
funding_or_conflicts: Fundamental Research Funds for the Central Universities (China). Authors declared no competing interests. Registered retrospectively.
verified_from: PubMed record and PMC full text
